name: Shrimp Linguini with Burst Cherry Tomato-Basil Sauce & Parmesan (Prep-Ahead)

ingredients.name: raw shrimp, peeled & deveined, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: This recipe utilizes 4 large food storage containers.

Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, uncover, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds; cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain pasta and set aside.
Meanwhile, preheat another large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, wash and dry the grape tomatoes.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tomatoes and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until the tomatoes burst, about 8 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash, dry, and pick basil leaves off the stems; discard stems and set leaves aside.
Peel and mince garlic. Set aside.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ lb raw shrimp, peeled & deveined, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: When the tomatoes start to burst, add garlic, shrimp, and pepper to the pot. Continue cook, stirring occasionally, until the sauce has thickened and shrimp are cooked through, 5-6 minutes. Add drained pasta and basil leaves, then toss to coat pasta in sauce. Remove from heat and set aside to cool completely.
When the pasta is cool, divide between containers and sprinkle with Parmesan; cover containers and refrigerate. When ready to eat, heat pasta in the oven or microwave and enjoy!
